head: Duo Remote: remote desktop iPhone app for Windows PCs and Macs
dek: Duo Remote is a new $1.99 iPhone app that shows and controls your Windows PC over Remote Desktop or your Mac over its built-in Screen Sharing. It was #99 in paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 24 November.
details: A laptop mode puts the computer's screen on the top half of the phone and a keyboard and trackpad on the bottom; on the foldable iPhone Duo the Windows desktop resizes when you open or close it. There's a key bar with Ctrl, Alt, Esc, Tab, arrows and Ctrl+Alt+Del. Windows needs Remote Desktop turned on, which Pro, Enterprise and Server editions have; Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 aren't supported. The listing warns that Mac Screen Sharing isn't encrypted after sign-in, so use it on a trusted network or a VPN.
where: iPhone (iOS 17 or later), $1.99, by Robert Menzel
means: If you sometimes need a file or program from your work computer while away from your desk, you can reach it from your iPhone.
todo: Check that your PC runs Windows Pro or that Screen Sharing is on in your Mac's settings before you buy it.
thumb_words: YOUR PC ON YOUR IPHONE: DUO REMOTE
